title: Omni-RS: Unifying Multi-Task Understanding and Generation in Remote Sensing
title_zh: Omni-RS：统一遥感领域的多任务理解与生成

paragraphs.en: Omni-RS 是一个支持遥感多任务理解与生成的统一框架。 Practical remote sensing applications often require both understanding and generation capabilities for the same geographic scene. However, most existing methods address either understanding or generation in isolation, while existing unified remote sensing models' generative ability is limited to text-to-image. To bridge this gap, we propose Omni-RS, a unified framework supporting four remote sensing understanding tasks and five generation tasks. Specifically, we introduce the "Scene-Guided Two-Stage Training" strategy, which first adapts a multimodal large language model to remote sensing understanding and then uses its hidden states to guide a diffusion transformer for image generation. To enable joint learning across diverse generation tasks, we construct UniGen, a unified multi-task generation dataset, by organizing heterogeneous remote sensing data into a unified format. Furthermore, we introduce "Detailed Visual Conditioning", which uses visual conditions encoded by a VAE to guide the generation process, thereby supporting additional generation tasks that require reference images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Omni-RS performs exceptionally well in understanding tasks and has achieved outstanding results in a variety of generative tasks.
paragraphs.zh: Omni-RS 是一个支持遥感多任务理解与生成的统一框架。实际的遥感应用通常需要针对同一地理场景同时具备理解与生成能力。 然而，大多数现有方法仅单独处理理解或生成任务，而现有的统一遥感模型其生成能力仅限于文本到图像。 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了 Omni-RS——一个支持四种遥感理解任务和五种生成任务的统一框架。 具体来说，我们引入了“场景引导两阶段训练”策略：首先将多模态大语言模型适配于遥感理解任务，然后利用其隐藏状态指导扩散变换器进行图像生成。 为了实现多样化生成任务的联合学习，我们通过将异构遥感数据组织为统一格式，构建了 UniGen——一个统一的跨任务生成数据集。 此外，我们还引入了“详细视觉条件约束”机制：该机制使用由 VAE 编码的视觉条件来指导生成过程，从而支持需要参考图像的其他生成任务。 大量实验表明，Omni-RS 在理解任务中表现优异，并在多种生成任务中取得了出色的结果。
